q1.question: What is the success rate of dental implants in India?
q1.answer: Indian dental clinics report dental implant success rates of 95-98% using premium implant systems from Nobel Biocare, Straumann, and other international brands. Advanced 3D imaging, computer-guided implant placement, and experienced implantologists ensure precise positioning and long-term stability at 60-70% lower costs than Western countries.

q2.question: How long does full mouth rehabilitation take in India?
q2.answer: Full mouth rehabilitation typically requires 2-4 weeks depending on complexity. The process includes initial consultation and planning (2-3 days), preparatory procedures and impressions (3-5 days), temporary restoration fitting, and final prosthesis placement. Indian dental centers offer comprehensive treatment with digital smile design and same-day dentistry options.

q3.question: What materials are used for dental crowns and veneers in India?
q3.answer: Indian dental labs use premium materials including high-quality zirconia, lithium disilicate (e.max), porcelain-fused-to-metal, and all-ceramic crowns. Veneers are crafted from ultra-thin porcelain or composite materials. All materials are biocompatible, FDA-approved, and manufactured in state-of-the-art dental laboratories with international quality standards.

q4.question: Is dental treatment in India painful?
q4.answer: Modern Indian dental clinics use advanced pain management including local anesthesia, sedation dentistry, and laser dentistry for minimally invasive procedures. Dentists follow international protocols for pain-free treatments. Most procedures are comfortable, and post-operative pain is well-managed with medications and proper care instructions.

q5.question: Can I get same-day dental crowns in India?
q5.answer: Yes, many advanced dental centers in India offer CEREC (Chairside Economical Restoration of Esthetic Ceramics) technology for same-day crowns, inlays, and onlays. Using CAD/CAM technology, dentists can design, mill, and place high-quality ceramic restorations in a single visit, saving time for international patients.
